$comment: Locks & Mane brand config for compile-brand-flow.cjs. Everything brand-specific lives HERE; the compiler and the runtime engine are generic. Encodes the 2026-07 spec: Rule Set 2 (2-sets conditions: above-shoulders / thick / blunt-cut), Rule Set 3 (length matrix), Rule Set 4 (shade maps), plus the 2026-08-10 closeout: 12"→16" shade routing (variantFallbackProducts). Two-set try-on prompts are PER PRODUCT with per-shade reference photos (migration 053) — managed by scripts/backfill-lm-two-set.cjs + scripts/lm-two-set-prompts/, not this config. 2026-08-10 REBASELINE: mirrors the LIVE admin-edited flow, which is extensions-only — the category question and Rule Set 1 accessory branch were removed in the admin editor after the 08-07 compile (parked under parkedAccessoryBranch below), and every question carries admin styling (helper texts, boxed/visual styles, relabeled options, emoji sublabels, length images) merged here verbatim so a recompile reproduces it and the destructive-save guard passes without --force. Product/variant names match the LIVE locks-mane.myshopify.com catalog verbatim (2026-08-07, mirrored into Gleame by backfill-lm-live-catalog.cjs). Remaining TODOs: Jenn's pony shade lookup + fallback adjacencies (placeholders are identity/neighbors).

products.$comment: Gleame product names (must match products.product_name exactly) — live locks-mane.myshopify.com titles. pony_14 kept because Example Response 2 references a 14″ ponytail even though the matrix only uses 18″.

variantFallbackProducts.$comment: Shade-not-offered routing (2026-08-10): the 12" clip-in carries only part of the shade range, so a shade it doesn't stock compiles to the 16" clip-in's variant in that shade instead of a shade-less 12" product target.

shadeVariantMap.$comment: hair_shade axis value → variant_title per product family (Rule Set 4). Live variant titles carry dye codes ('Vanilla #613'), so both maps use the coded titles. clip_in uses the AI shade directly; ponytail is Jenn's lookup map — TODO Jenn: real mapping, placeholder is same-shade for now. Shades a product doesn't stock route through variantFallbackProducts at compile time (12" → 16").

shadeFallbacks.$comment: TODO Jenn: nearest-shade adjacencies (used only when the availability filter finds a shade fully out of stock). Written to chat_assistant_config.quiz_shade_fallbacks. Placeholder = simple neighbors in the depth scale above.

setsTable.$comment: Rule Set 2 — 2026-07-31 spec: recommend TWO sets only when the shopper has short hair (above shoulders), super thick hair, or blunt-cut hair; everyone else gets 1. Rows are effectively OR'd (first match wins, every row yields 2, default 1). Replaces the old layers/thickness table and RESOLVES the 07-16 open question: goal=both no longer forces 2 sets — quantity comes solely from these three conditions.

matrix.$comment: Rule Set 3 — 2026-07-31 lengths table: current_length × goal → hero clip-in and optional complementary ponytail. Set counts are NOT encoded per cell anymore; quantity comes entirely from setsTable. 'pony' omitted = single-recommendation cell (the whole above-shoulders row and at-shoulders+volume have no ponytail in the table).

parkedAccessoryBranch.$comment: Rule Set 1 (accessory branch by style intent), PARKED 2026-08-10: the live admin-edited flow removed the category question and runs extensions-only, so none of this compiles (the compiler ignores this key). To relaunch accessories: rename 'accessories' back to the top level, restore the category axis {extensions, accessories} + the 'What are you looking for today?' question, and re-add showIf {category: extensions} to the goal/current_length/thickness/blunt_cut questions. Names are the LIVE locks-mane.myshopify.com product titles (2026-08-07). Column-by-column reading of the 2026-07-15 15-URL list — confirm with Jenn.
